chapterInfo.content:
7
Akɔnkyene ho asɛmmisa
1Na Ɔhene Dario afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu no, AWURADE asɛm baa Sakaria nkyɛn, bosome a ɛtɔ so nkron a ɛne Kislew no da a ɛtɔ so nnan. 2Na Betelfoɔ somaa Sareser ne Regem-Melek ne ne nnipa baa sɛ wɔmmɛkoto nsrɛ AWURADE anim, 3#Sak 8.19; Yer 52.12 na wɔmmisa asafo AWURADE fie asɔfoɔ ne adiyifoɔ no sɛ: Mensu bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no so, na menkyere kɔm, sɛdeɛ meyɛɛ no mfeɛ dodoɔ a ɛte sɛɛ yi anaa? 4Ɛnna asafo AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 5#Sak 8.19; Yes 58.5 Bisa asase no so nyinaa ne asɔfoɔ no sɛ: Mokyenee kɔm na modii abooboo, bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum ne deɛ ɛtɔ so nson so, mfeɛ aduɔson yi no, akɔnkyene yi, moyɛ maa me anaa? 6Nanso sɛ modidi na monom nso a, ɛnyɛ mo ara na modidie na monom anaa? 7Ɛnyɛ nsɛm yi na AWURADE nam akane adiyifoɔ so maa wɔpaeeɛ, berɛ a Yerusalem da so wɔ hɔ a na wɔte mu na emu dwoɔ, na ne nkuro atwa ho ahyia, na wɔtete Negeb ne mpaperɛ soɔ no anaa?
Deɛ Onyankopɔn hwehwɛ firi teteete
8Na AWURADE asɛm baa Sakaria nkyɛn sɛ: 9#Mika 6.8 Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Mommu nokwatɛn, na onipa ne ne nua nni no adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu so. 10#Eks 22.21-22 Na monnhyɛ okunafoɔ ne awisiaa, ɔhɔhoɔ ne ɔmanehunufoɔ so, na obiara nnnwene ne nua ho bɔne n’akomam. 11Nanso wɔampene sɛ wɔtie, na wɔwosoo wɔn mmati, na wɔsoroo wɔn aso na wɔante. 12#Yes 48.4 Na wɔyɛɛ wɔn akoma sɛ ahwehwɛboɔ, na wɔantie mmara ne nsɛm a asafo AWURADE nam ne honhom so maa akane adiyifoɔ no bɛkaeɛ no, na ɛmaa abufuhyeɛ kɛseɛ firi asafo AWURADE nkyɛn baeɛ no. 13Na sɛdeɛ me frɛeɛ na wɔantie no, saa nso na wɔbɛfrɛ na merentie, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 14Na me de ahum bɛfa wɔn akɔ amanaman a wɔnni wɔn nyinaa mu, na wɔn akyiri asase no adane afo, na obi ara amfa so ankɔ ansane amma, na wɔama asase fɛfɛ no adane afo.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Ɔhene Dario afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu no, AWURADE asɛm baa Sakaria nkyɛn, bosome a ɛtɔ so nkron a ɛne Kislew no da a ɛtɔ so nnan. Na Betelfoɔ somaa Sareser ne Regem-Melek ne ne nnipa baa sɛ wɔmmɛkoto nsrɛ AWURADE anim, na wɔmmisa asafo AWURADE fie asɔfoɔ ne adiyifoɔ no sɛ: Mensu bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no so, na menkyere kɔm, sɛdeɛ meyɛɛ no mfeɛ dodoɔ a ɛte sɛɛ yi anaa? Ɛnna asafo AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Bisa asase no so nyinaa ne asɔfoɔ no sɛ: Mokyenee kɔm na modii abooboo, bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum ne deɛ ɛtɔ so nson so, mfeɛ aduɔson yi no, akɔnkyene yi, moyɛ maa me anaa? Nanso sɛ modidi na monom nso a, ɛnyɛ mo ara na modidie na monom anaa? Ɛnyɛ nsɛm yi na AWURADE nam akane adiyifoɔ so maa wɔpaeeɛ, berɛ a Yerusalem da so wɔ hɔ a na wɔte mu na emu dwoɔ, na ne nkuro atwa ho ahyia, na wɔtete Negeb ne mpaperɛ soɔ no anaa?

Na AWURADE asɛm baa Sakaria nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Mommu nokwatɛn, na onipa ne ne nua nni no adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu so. Na monnhyɛ okunafoɔ ne awisiaa, ɔhɔhoɔ ne ɔmanehunufoɔ so, na obiara nnnwene ne nua ho bɔne n’akomam. Nanso wɔampene sɛ wɔtie, na wɔwosoo wɔn mmati, na wɔsoroo wɔn aso na wɔante. Na wɔyɛɛ wɔn akoma sɛ ahwehwɛboɔ, na wɔantie mmara ne nsɛm a asafo AWURADE nam ne honhom so maa akane adiyifoɔ no bɛkaeɛ no, na ɛmaa abufuhyeɛ kɛseɛ firi asafo AWURADE nkyɛn baeɛ no. Na sɛdeɛ me frɛeɛ na wɔantie no, saa nso na wɔbɛfrɛ na merentie, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Na me de ahum bɛfa wɔn akɔ amanaman a wɔnni wɔn nyinaa mu, na wɔn akyiri asase no adane afo, na obi ara amfa so ankɔ ansane amma, na wɔama asase fɛfɛ no adane afo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
